video_title: Caleb Wilson is the 'bright light' Chicago Bulls fans can follow! 👀 - Sean Farnham | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' new contract does not impact the Lakers' salary cap flexibility
quotes.excerpt: This doesn't impact the rest of the decisions the Lakers have in front of them this summer
quotes.quote: This doesn't impact the rest of the decisions the Lakers have in front of them this summer because Austin Reaves is going to remain officially on that cap hold. This contract is agreed to now but won't be signed until the Lakers take care of the rest of their summer business so they can preserve the salary cap space that they have. Their negotiations with LeBron James are completely a separate entity from this. How much flexibility they have to build out the rest of the roster around Luka Doncic and his long-term co-star Austin Reaves, that depends in large part on the negotiations with LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder and Spurs draft picks address specific roster flaws
quotes.excerpt: They were both able to add a pair of first-round picks to address flaws
quotes.quote: They were both able to add a pair of first-round picks to address flaws that showed up as they made their exits deep in the playoffs this year. For Oklahoma City, they're going to have to deal with Victor Wembanyama for years to come. Well, go get you a 7'3" guy in Aday Mara, who is obviously defensive-minded, as well as Bennett Stirtz, a really dynamic pick-and-roll playmaker and shooter, where they had some entries and that was really an issue for them when they lost to the Spurs. And then the Spurs, as great as Wembanyama is, he can't play 48 minutes and Luke Kornet was a great addition for them during the regular season that they were able to rely on less and less as they got deeper into the playoffs. So you get Jayden Quaintance and Tarris Reed Jr. Quaintance is unfortunately, he's got a serious knee issue, there might be another surgery. We'll see how much he's able to contribute for them as a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson is the best player in the 2026 NBA Draft
quotes.excerpt: When we look back at this draft four or five years from now, Caleb Wilson might end up
quotes.quote: When we look back at this draft four or five years from now, Caleb Wilson might end up being the best player in this draft. He's really worked on his shot, he's got an incredible motor. You hear him talking and he said, 'I want to be better than Michael Jordan,' and he goes, 'that's a lot, but that's his drive.' You want that mentality as you enter into the NBA. And then you add that with Dailyn Swain, who is a 3-and-D threat who really improved his three-point shot as the season went along last year. He can defend and he is long out on the perimeter. I think they found two starters in the first round of this draft last night.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Richie Saunders' ACL injury caused him to fall to the second round
quotes.excerpt: Richie Saunders is a guy that's coming back from an ACL injury
quotes.quote: Richie Saunders is a guy that's coming back from an ACL injury. But you look at his splits over the last two seasons as a starter at BYU, average over 17 points per game, 51% from the field, 41% from deep, 83% from the free-throw line. He's an excellent rebounder from the guard position, incredible leader, motor. Everything of that grades out as a first-round pick. If he didn't have the ACL injury, that's exactly where he would have been. Instead, he'll get called in night two. He's ahead of schedule in his recovery from what I've been told.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Evans is an incredible value pick for the second round
quotes.excerpt: He's going to get drafted and he's going to be an incredible value here in night number two
quotes.quote: Isaiah Evans was a young man that sat in the green room, was expected to hear his name last night. It didn't happen. I'm sure it's heartbreaking, I'm sure it was frustrating, but the talent that he brings to the court, the ability to defend, the ability to stretch from the outside, he's going to get drafted and he's going to be an incredible value here in night number two.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Mitchell is an elite passer but needs to improve his shooting
quotes.excerpt: He can impact the game without scoring. He is an elite level passer for his size
quotes.quote: Dillon Mitchell. I mean, you talk about a guy that can impact the game without scoring. He is an elite level passer for his size, he rebounds, he can defend multiple positions. When you play for Rick Pitino, you've got to be able to lock up at the defensive end of the floor. The one area he's got to continue to improve is his shot. He struggles to shoot the ball really outside of the paint, over 80% of his made field goals this year came inside the paint, which is why he's a second-round pick and was not a first-round pick.
